parent_stage4_freeze: freeze.json; preserve original unchanged; SHA-256 supplied and externally recalculated by project reviewer; byte identity on runner to be verified before episode execution

safety_and_source_limits.service_bulletin_reference_policy: Do not add bulletin/reproduction unless public official source verified; any workshop thresholds are context only, never numerical BMS diagnostic thresholds.

split_policy.existing_seeded_TR01_TR02_TE01_TE02: Retain historical IDs and seeds; no retroactive renaming, repeated measurements of previous comparisons excluded from new post-freeze scoring.
split_policy.new_seed_generation: Per episode use SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 string 'TAYCAN4R|<hypothesis>|<split>|<severity>|<replicate>|<physics|observer|aux|nuisance>', take first 8 hexadecimal digits as unsigned 32-bit integer; stable ordering and episode manifest written before running. Existing TR/TE historical seeds unchanged; revised episodes get new keys.
split_policy.nuisance_draw_policy: Randomize continuous nuisance scales uniformly in registered ranges using precommitted nuisance seed; persistent bias uniform within sampled half-width per sensor per episode, white innovations at each step. Assign structural factors acquisition_mode, counter_source and diff_motor_t_mapping by balanced deterministic 8-combo strata and SOC phi by 7-level deterministic round robin (see structural_nuisance_design); no parameter selected by outcomes. For paired faults use same environmental nuisance realization and stratification.
split_policy.validation_usage: Validation only for model/baseline selection and threshold settings; test locked until selected design frozen.

distribution_shift_pre_registered.reference: Train H00 nominal profile at assumed 25C ambient, if existing frozen Stage3 interface supports it.
distribution_shift_pre_registered.scenario: Whole-episode six-hour shifted driving profile with more regeneration and lower traction torque; nominal ambient 10C if existing interface supports it. Use same fixed training-derived charging boundary for matched hypotheses; no per-test tuning.
distribution_shift_pre_registered.allocation: Each hypothesis including H00 has three quota/severity strata; in each stratum run TWO independent 16-episode test blocks. In EACH block: 8 NOMINAL + 8 SHIFTED, exactly one per acquisition_mode×counter_source×diff_motor_t_mapping combination for each profile. Therefore 16 nominal+16 shifted per stratum, 48+48 per hypothesis, 576+576 overall. For H00 strata are quota labels only. Training/validation remain nominal and use the block/remainder assignment rule.

statistical_precision_pre_registered.primary_unit: episode with disjoint seeds; paired observations must be clustered appropriately
statistical_precision_pre_registered.warning: Approximate Wald/binomial widths only, not achieved measured coverage, and assume independent successes; primary report acquisition_mode with n≈48 per class each; secondary counter_source/DIFF pooled over strata, severity and profile, with n and intervals; Wilson CIs and clustered episode bootstrap preferred. Train n20 and validation n10 strata are approximately balanced, not exact eight-way balanced.

structural_nuisance_design.method: Balanced, fixed stratification instead of stochastic discovery; all combinations treated as methodological alternatives, not true Porsche design.
structural_nuisance_design.counter_source_truth: EXCLUDED from main evaluation; optional explicitly labeled truth ablation only (not observable)
structural_nuisance_design.assignment: Eight lexicographically ordered combinations of acquisition_mode (independent/shared) × counter_source (BMS_I/HVBAT_CURRENT) × diff_motor_t_mapping (winding_proxy/uninformative). For EACH hypothesis×severity×split, use deterministic SHA256-derived cyclic rotation to order combinations. TRAIN n20=2 full blocks of eight + first four of rotated third block (residue four); VALIDATION n10=1 full block + first two of rotated next block (residue two). Fixed nuisance seeds are unique per episode; report per-factor counts; repeated residues distributed by deterministic class/split/severity rotation, not tuned by outcomes. TEST n32 per severity = TWO preregistered independent replicate blocks, each with exactly 8 NOMINAL + 8 SHIFTED, one episode per structural combination per profile. H00 uses three pseudo-severity planning strata only, without injecting severity and without treating it as a predictor. The 16-episode blocks satisfy the user's exact 8+8 structure, and the second independent replication preserves the earlier >=50 blind-test-episodes-per-hypothesis requirement.

soc_phi_assignment.method: Deterministic 7-level round robin over ordered independent episode indices within each hypothesis and split; rotation SHA256 of 'TAYCAN4R|phi|hypothesis|split' first byte %7, then assign grid[(replicate_global+offset)%7]. Applied to observer only; never retune by performance; make φ≥0.9995 sensitivity runs mandatory in both nominal and shifted subsets.
soc_phi_assignment.sensitivity: Per φ report measured bias/drift, error SD, diagnostic metric stratification, and exact-dt AR1 innovations; if φ leads clipping, record clipping frequency. The test may use high φ out-of-original-assumption-range 0.995; explicitly declared hypothetical extension.

structural_nuisance_design.nuisance_draw_scope: Per-episode continuous ranges from existing parameters_assumed (uniform sampling fixed seeds), while structural factors and φ follow the fixed assignment schedule.

energy_balanced_long_horizon.charging_boundary: Negative battery-side DC power injected before electrical balance; no charger/OBC subsystem simulated
energy_balanced_long_horizon.charge_power_design: For EACH prespecified driving profile (nominal and shifted), simulate independent training-only H00 reference 6h with fixed initial SOC; bisect battery-side charging power within [0,120] kW for at least 8 iterations and up to 12, testing final |SOC(6h)-SOC(0)|<=0.5 percentage point and full trajectory 30..80% at each iteration. Freeze ONE power per profile, reused for all fault classes, severities, structural modes, validation and test within that profile. Do not optimize on validation/test outcomes. Declare convergence failure (BLOCK) instead of silently adjusting.
energy_balanced_long_horizon.stress_abort_rule: If resulting battery model SOC crosses 30..80%, mark boundary violation and report with attempted energy and cause; do not clip or silently exclude.
energy_balanced_long_horizon.previous_results_6h: SUPERSEDED; do not use old B01 B02 B04 metrics

charge_power_bisection.termination: both after >=8 iterations and |SOC_final - SOC_initial| <=0.5 percentage point, AND min/max SOC within [30,80]%; otherwise up to 12 iterations. If not met, record nonconvergence and DO NOT run dependent episodes.
charge_power_bisection.linearized_sanity: With 6 x 12min charge blocks and ASSUMED 70 kWh usable capacity, ∂SOC_final/∂P≈(1.2 h /70kWh)*100 =1.7142857 pp/kW. Bracket width at iteration 8:120/2^8=0.46875 kW; half-width 0.234375 kW implies approx 0.4018 pp worst midpoint quantization. Nonlinear dynamics still require explicit simulator residual.

energy_balanced_long_horizon.confounding_guard: Same duration (6 h), numerical dt, SOC initial state and segment lengths in nominal and shifted. Only prespecified duty cycle and optionally supported ambient parameter differ; do not conflate duration and shift.

matched_M01_I01.objective: For EACH prespecified profile NOMINAL_6H / SHIFT_REGEN_COLD_6H, compare mean extra joules vs profile-specific H00 reference: compute ΔE_motor and ΔE_inverter using only distinct calibration episodes and frozen Stage3 truth diagnostics; match integrated positive dissipative loss (J) within <=1% tolerance and document failures. Keep reference seeds separate from validation/test; avoid use of final held-out outcomes.
matched_M01_I01.severity_mapping: Calibrate motor→inverter map SEPARATELY for nominal and shifted full 6h driving profiles using independent, declared calibration/reference seeds (not any validation or test episode outcomes); freeze mapping before test generation. M01 ~ torque^2, so do not reuse a nominal map on the shifted profile. Report actual ΔE in J, ΔPmean in W, mismatch %, and cases outside feasible I01 severity.
matched_M01_I01.separability: Report distributions/overlap and paired effect-size; DO NOT invent classifier/AUC without Stage5; do not use truth channel to derive R33.

performance_stratification.noise_terciles_definition: Before any classification, use observed *assigned* sensor-noise scales only (no labels/results): score sqrt((sigma_torque_Nm/8)^2+(sigma_rpm/35)^2) using per-episode draws; train split alone fixes 1/3 and 2/3 score quantile edges for low/medium/high; freeze and apply same boundaries to val/test. Persistent bias is stratified separately, not folded into white noise score.
report: R33 regression on [1, sum torque_j, sum torque_j_squared, sum omega_j, sum torque_j*omega_j] using OBSERVED torque/RPM only
mean and SD of observed R33 by fault, severity, profile, noise tercile and acquisition_mode
coefficients SE and 95% interval clustered by episode
primary diagnostic accuracy by acquisition_mode, class, severity, noise tercile and nominal/shift profiles, always with counts and intervals
counter_source and diff_motor_t_mapping as POOLED secondary nuisance strata, with no class-wise eight-way headline claim
bias retained versus oracle-only bias removed
rank/collinearity diagnostics and low-severity unidentifiability caveat
performance_stratification.regression_caveat: Persistent torque bias enters approximately as a term proportional to omega; RPM bias enters approximately as a term proportional to torque; copper excess follows torque²; efficiency and mechanical conversion follow torque·omega. With only aggregated sums, arbitrary sensor-specific biases are not fully identifiable; power-residual intercept confounds I01 and auxiliaries. Rank diagnostics and conditional interpretation are obligatory.

coefficients_interpretation.1: constant extra losses, auxiliary load and persistent baseline offset; cannot identify inverter in isolation
coefficients_interpretation.Σ_j τ_j: RPM measurement bias contributes to inferred P_mechanical approximately -k Σ_j τ_j δRPM_j; mode-dependent nuisance
coefficients_interpretation.Σ_j τ_j²: motor copper/resistive loss model M01 proportional to torque squared
coefficients_interpretation.Σ_j ω_j: torque measurement bias contributes approximately -Σ_j ω_j δτ_j
coefficients_interpretation.Σ_j(τ_j·ω_j): efficiency-scaled mechanical power losses and torque×angular-speed coupling; potentially collinear with observed R33 under restricted profiles

regression_basis.fitting_guard: Compute R33(t) from observed voltage, current, torques and angular speeds only. Estimate five coefficients by fixed OLS, using the existing fixed 1e-9 numerical regularizer only when required by the preexisting feature pipeline; report design rank and condition number; never silently interpret singular coefficients. Fit quality assessed by whole episode, not by shuffled seconds; numeric stability flags not hidden.
regression_basis.accuracy_reporting: Primary by acquisition_mode within each hypothesis and severity; secondary counter_source and diff_motor_t_mapping pooled, report profile and noise tercile with denominators; no statistical significance presumed in sparse cells.

external_validation_protocol.model_class: One-RC Thevenin ECM primary; independent two-RC Thevenin ECM reference benchmark fitted/evaluated on identical cell-level partitions. Frozen Stage3 Taycan model.py remains unchanged.
ocv_models: linear voltage vs SOC as frozen model.py functional form
degree-3 polynomial in SOC, constrained/evaluated on 0..1 domain
external_validation_protocol.fit_only: LG E66 cell HPPC, GITT, C20 and C/3 files at -20,-10,10,25 degC; files enumerated from original archive manifest before new numerical fitting; no module or whole-pack fitting
external_validation_protocol.validate: LG E66 development temperatures (-20,-10,10,25°C): ONLY Dis_0p5C is validation. Dis_1C is reserved as BLIND_TYPE for all development temperatures. At temperature holdouts 0 and 40°C, EVERY test type is BLIND_TEMPERATURE. 25°C Drive Cycle already exposed: DEVELOPMENT_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, not blind.
external_validation_protocol.predictions: terminal V(t) under measured current profile using known initial SOC from development protocol (no fitted test SOC) and frozen input temperature treatment
external_validation_protocol.metrics: Session-level RMSE and MAE of terminal voltage in volts (and mV display), stratified by temperature and test type; compare ECM_1RC_LINEAR_OCV, ECM_1RC_CUBIC_OCV, ECM_2RC_CUBIC_OCV fitted only on development-fit; report OCV model difference and independent blind-pair results. Proposed good <=30mV, acceptable <=60mV, else fail, with source-literature benchmark held NOT VERIFIED.
external_validation_protocol.primary_threshold_assumed: Session-level blind cell-voltage RMSE <=0.030 V: GOOD; >0.030 and <=0.060 V: ACCEPTABLE; >0.060 V: FAIL. These are PRE-ASSUMED engineering categories, not Porsche or McMaster pass thresholds; report each regime/temperature, session macro and tail/worst-case regardless of category.
external_validation_protocol.scope: Tests transfer of ECM structure under cell-scale experimental regimes. Does not validate the 2022 Taycan 4S pack simulator or certified HV diagnosis.

reference_models.purpose: structural error floor comparator only, not a replacement for frozen Stage3

literature_benchmark.target: Numerical terminal-voltage RMSE from original McMaster thesis for LG E66 cell using second-order ECM, if available and confirmed
literature_benchmark.status: NÃO VERIFICADO / DO NOT SUBSTITUTE NUMBERS
literature_benchmark.search_evidence: McMaster Uwalaka 2024 ITEC cell/module performance publication located (https://doi.org/10.1109/ITEC60657.2024.10599015), but no reproducible numerical 2RC voltage RMSE figure for identical LG E66 split found in verified source; 2026 Energy paper uses LG E66 1RC/2RC but is not McMaster thesis.
literature_benchmark.policy: No external quantitative comparison until exact thesis citation, figure/table, voltage units, cell identity, temperature, current sequence, SOC initialization and evaluation regime are verified. Meanwhile calculate internal 2RC RMSE on identical held-out LG E66 sessions as reference; label internal, NOT literature benchmark.
literature_benchmark.source_to_verify: Original thesis PDF/DOI or institutional repository page, not only a cited abstract.

temperature_transfer_protocol.status: PRE-SEALED; no new LG E66 numerical time series opened
temperature_transfer_protocol.resistance_arrhenius: For i=0,1, and i=2 only in 2RC: ln R_i(T)=alpha_Ri + beta_Ri * (1/T_K - 1/T_ref). Fit alpha and beta ONLY on temperature development-fit sessions. Enforces R_i>0; is a phenomenological Arrhenius-like law, not claim of actual chemistry mechanism.
temperature_transfer_protocol.capacitance_temperature: For i=1 (and i=2 in 2RC): ln C_i(T)=alpha_Ci + beta_Ci * (1/T_K - 1/T_ref). Fit on development-fit only; C_i>0. Every parameter inferred at blinded temperature solely from these frozen formulas.
temperature_transfer_protocol.OCV_temperature: For linear or cubic OCV in SOC s, OCV(s,T)=SUM_{k=0}^p [a_k+b_k*(T_K-T_ref)]*s^k, p=1 or p=3. Fit all coefficients on development-fit temperatures only, no tuning on blind temperatures. Enforce monotonic OCV for 0<=s<=1 if feasible under development constraints; failure must be flagged, not secretly fixed after holdout.
temperature_transfer_protocol.capacity_25C: Estimate Q25_Ah from the already EXPOSED 25C C20Dis using elapsed time and negative-discharge current convention Q=integral(|I_discharge| dt)/3600 in ampere-hours; compare independently with absolute delta Ah counter. Only label 'capacity' if record starts fully charged, ends at documented cut-off and no discontinuous time/status; otherwise label observed discharged throughput and mark Q25 non-identifiable. No fixed 60/65/64.6 nominal imposed.
temperature_transfer_protocol.capacity_transfer: If a complete usable Q25 estimate exists, set ln Q(T)=ln Q25 + beta_Q*(1/T_K-1/T_ref), with beta_Q fitted exclusively to complete development C20 discharges at -20,-10,10 C and Q25 anchor, positive Q. If development data cannot identify beta_Q, fix beta_Q=0 and explicitly flag this as an ASSUMED constant-capacity fallback predeclared here; do not choose based on any blind holdout.
temperature_transfer_protocol.interpretation: At 0 C formula evaluates inside development temperature range but still model-based interpolation; at 40 C extrapolates beyond 25 C and must report extrapolation flag and predictive uncertainty. Independent cells tested at different temperatures can confound temperature effect with cell variability; report limitation and no Taycan pack claims.
temperature_transfer_protocol.two_RC: For 2RC fit R0/R1/C1/R2/C2 with same formulas; impose tau1=R1*C1 <= tau2=R2*C2 in all development temperatures to avoid branch label switching, and report failures or poor identifiability without using blind data.

LG_E66_split.metadata_manifest_previously_generated: LG_E66_MANIFEST.json; complete archive member paths/CRC/size originally catalogued
cell_test_types_blind_holdout: Drive Cycles at development temperatures EXCEPT pre-exposed 25degC recording
LG_E66_split.previously_exposed_policy: Any pre-inspected LG E66 numerical series, specifically 25C HPPC, C20Dis and Drive Cycle, must never contribute to blind test claims. 25C HPPC/C20Dis may be used for development; 25C drive cycle descriptive only unless explicit prospective development fit protocol; 0C/40C uninspected numerical holdouts preserved.
LG_E66_split.nominal_capacity_conflict: README says 65 Ah; McMaster catalog labels dataset 60 Ah; BatteryDesign secondary lists nominal 64.6 Ah (minimum 63.5 Ah) for E66a. Do not silently choose any; predefine development-only C20Dis 25C integration and its completeness QC as experimental estimate.
LG_E66_split.license: CC BY 4.0 confirmed in both original README files

previous_numeric_exposure.25degC Drive Cycle: EXPOSED_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; 858862 observations inspected pre-freeze; prohibited as virgin blind holdout

LG_E66_split.single_source_of_truth_for_split: temperature_test_role_table overrides earlier per-type shorthand, includes explicit pre-exposed 25C HPPC and C20Dis; no fit from any blind cell time series

capacity_source_discrepancy.resolution: Do not declare one nominal correct from sources alone. Estimate measured available discharged Ah from EXPOSED 25degC C20Dis only under full-cycle completeness tests; report estimated value, integration convention, first/last timestamp, cutoffs, uncertainties, and difference from all three source claims. No use of 0/40C holdouts for selection.

LG_E66_split.capacity_calibration_stage: RULE SEALED; numerical capacity estimate NOT EXECUTED in this revision.

Oxford_split.policy_pre_registered: Flag all rows, preserve all metadata. Exclude flagged trajectories from primary OCV/ECM fitting and primary holdout metrics, retain in raw QC and report secondary sensitivity with flags. Do not open or alter blind Cell7/8 before model freeze.
Oxford_split.inferred_q_units: Likely mAh because |q| up to ~745 for published nominal 740 mAh; INFERENCE not proved by manufacturer metadata.

metrics_and_baselines.multiclass_Brier: mean_i sum_classes (p_ic-1[y_i=c])^2; all 12 classes; report uncertainty by episodes
metrics_and_baselines.ECE: 10 fixed-width confidence bins over [0,1], top-class confidence ECE; also reliability table
metrics_and_baselines.expected_cost: per-episode sum over class posterior times assumed loss of chosen action
metrics_and_baselines.assumed_loss_matrix: correct=0; false-positive on H00=1; missed non-H00 fault as H00=10; incorrect non-H00 fault subtype=4
baselines: physics-rule residual thresholds fit on train and chosen on validation
regularized multinomial logistic regression on identical observed features, train-only standardization, validation-only tuning
metrics_and_baselines.evaluation_design: Holdout by whole episode / whole cell. Macro by episode, paired bootstrap by episode, do not split correlated timestamps across train and test.
metrics_and_baselines.baseline_guard: No classifier, network or fitting during unapproved Stage 4, except preregistration. Stage 5+ performance metrics specified but not executed; do not label pre-registration as passed acceptance.

observation_unit_and_features.observation_unit: ONE 6-hour independently seeded episode (not individual sample, not vehicle); observations at each 5- or 10-second numerical step. Full episode is assigned to exactly one train/validation/test split. With paired scenarios cluster uncertainties by independent seed/profile group.
observation_unit_and_features.per_step_raw_channels: Only the following preapproved OBDb IDs and 28x6 group-voltage / 28x3 module-temperature families: TAYCAN_HVBAT_VOLT, TAYCAN_BMS_I, TAYCAN_HVBAT_CURRENT, TAYCAN_BMS_SOC, TAYCAN_HVBAT_SOC_DISP, TAYCAN_EM_TORQ_1/2, TAYCAN_EM_RPM_1/2, TAYCAN_DIFF_MOTOR_T, TAYCAN_HV_ISO_POS_SYS, TAYCAN_HV_ISO_NEG_SYS, TAYCAN_HVBAT_ISO_POS, TAYCAN_HVBAT_ISO_NEG, TAYCAN_HVBAT_MOD{1..28}_C{1..6}_V, TAYCAN_HVBAT_MOD{1..28}_T{1..3}. No truth, labels, injected severities, fault power, parameters or seeds as features.
observation_unit_and_features.temporal_aggregation: Use only finite observed channels; build derived signals at each step. For R33 regress on fixed [1, Στ, Στ², Σω, Στω]. Aggregate exactly 27 predeclared features; sample SD ddof=1, unweighted OLS slopes on hours, linear-interpolated quantiles, and fixed regression numeric regularizer 1e-9 when applicable; report rank-deficient fits NA + masks. Any missing data impute using TRAIN-only medians with fixed masks; no feature selection using labels/test.
observation_unit_and_features.canonical_missingness: If a required channel is genuinely not emitted under a structural mode, numeric feature becomes NA, recorded with fixed 0/1 mask. Median training-only imputation and mask appended, so classifiers see the identical numeric+mask vector. Never replace missing sensors with simulated true states or silently zero.
observation_unit_and_features.shared_inputs_rule: All Stage 5+ episode-level baselines and supervised comparators consume the SAME 27 numeric feature values plus 27 missingness masks, with training-only imputation/scaling; the DBN can additionally operate on the fixed preapproved per-step observables only, and comparisons must state their interface explicitly. Any expansion requires approval.
observation_unit_and_features.label_and_meta_policy: Hypothesis label used only as outcome, never feature. Severity, structural mode, nuisance scales, φ, profile ID, seeds, initial SOC, injected faults and latent truth are metadata for splits/stratified reporting only, NOT predictor features. No using access to held-out outcomes for feature selection.
